changelog: **The support line sends push notifications (#3154):** until now only messages pushed (`sendNewMessagePush`); the support channel wrote bell rows only, so a support message never reached a phone with the app closed. `POST /api/support` now also pushes to the active ADMINs of the requester's org (the bell's `orgWhere(ticketOrgId)` list, link `/admin/support`), and an admin's reply in `POST /api/admin/support` pushes to the requester (`notificationLink(role, 'support', {})`). The writer is never pushed about their own message, and `support.closed` deliberately writes the bell row only. Both go through the new `sendSupportPush()` (`src/lib/messagePush.ts`, sharing the body of the message push) → `sendPushToUser(…, 'messages', …)` — the catalogue's category for every support event, so the /account "Messages" switch silences tray and bell alike. The title is the bell's own template (no new i18n key); the tag is `support:<ticketId>`. Which events push, to whom, and the one-line preview cut are pure in `src/lib/supportPushRule.ts`, unit-tested in `scripts/test/support-push.test.mjs` (coverage floor 95). The mobile app needs no change: neither path is native, so a tap opens the web view. `docs/mobile-push.md` § The shape and § Known gaps updated.

en: Support messages now arrive as push notifications: admins are notified on their phone or browser when someone writes to support, and you are notified when support replies.
tr: Destek mesajları artık anlık bildirim olarak geliyor: biri desteğe yazdığında admin'ler telefonda ya da tarayıcıda haberdar oluyor, destek yanıt verdiğinde de sen haberdar oluyorsun.
de: Support-Nachrichten kommen jetzt als Push-Benachrichtigung: Admins werden auf dem Handy oder im Browser benachrichtigt, wenn jemand dem Support schreibt, und du, wenn der Support antwortet.
